text:
incident-bot: P0 ALERT — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for redwood-api-prod (ingress -> gateway -> inference). start=1768510000, error-rate jump and p99 latency spike. paging oncall-sre.

ashok: i'm on it. seeing a spike of 502/504 and a couple of 429s in the ingress. region: us-east-1 (nyc). queue depth on gateway worker queues is high. checking recent deploys and connection metrics.

maria: infra note: database connection pools look fine. i see a simultaneous increase in backend TLS handshake errors from cache-proxy cluster. could be a transient cert rotation? pulling logs.

kevin: i pushed cache-proxy v1.13 at 1768509800 for a minor header change — marking that as suspect. starting rollback to v1.12 now.

ashok: good call. switching traffic for nyc to fallback gateway path (force-route to secondary balancer) to reduce head-of-line blocking. reducing region weight to 0.1 while we investigate.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by kevin: cache-proxy -> v1.12 (rollback id rb-1768510050).

ashok: also bumping inference replicas for model-pool-b from 8 to 14 to absorb retries. adding temporary limit on client retries to 1 in edge config.

tess: customer-facing: chats and code-gen completions timing out for some customers. i'm drafting a brief status update for support. can we get an impact estimate?

ashok: rough impact: 1.3% of requests returned errors between 1768509980-1768510200. endpoints hit: /v1/chat/completions and /v1/embeddings. heavy-tail affected customers with sustained high TPS.

maria: cert rotation theory ruled out — certs are fine. TLS errors are coming from connection resets between gateway and cache-proxy (RST). looks like cache-proxy is emitting too many connections late in its lifecycle after the v1.13 change.

kevin: rollback complete. cache-proxy v1.12 is active. early signals: error rate moving down but p99 still elevated.

ashok: applied circuit-breaker on cache-proxy to abort requests that take >120ms to avoid queuing. also enabled 10% probabilistic drop on requests over 200ms to protect downstream.

jordan: product: which customers were hit? we need a scoped list for targeted outreach.

ashok: initial list: customers A, B, C (high TPS) and a handful of mid-market teams. tess, can you coordinate support outreach?

tess: yes — sending to support feed and starting targeted msg to A/B/C with ETA.

maria: added dashboard panel for gateway queue-length and per-backend connection resets, set retention to 72h for the spike window.

ashok: timeline so far:
- 1768509800: cache-proxy v1.13 rollout completed
- 1768509980: small increase in connection resets and p99
- 1768510000: incident-bot anomaly (elevated 5xx/p99)
- 1768510050: rollback started (rb-1768510050)
- 1768510105: circuit-breaker and retry reductions applied
- 1768510190: error-rate trending down

kevin: commands used during mitigation:
```
# rollback cache-proxy
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=172

# reduce region weight
redwood routing set-weight --region us-east-1 --weight 0.1 --auth $KEY

# set circuit-breaker
redwood policy set cb --service cache-proxy --timeout-ms 120 --max-conns 200
```

ashok: alerts/actions post-incident (short list):
- tune 5xx paging to require sustained >0.5% error rate for 3m before paging (ashok, 24h)
- add gateway connection-reset metric to oncall dashboard with a 5m rolling alarm (maria, 48h)
- add canary-step verification for cache-proxy header-change rollouts (kevin, 72h)
- add client-side retry-backoff jitter doc + reduce default retries for 5xx (tess, 48h)

kevin: i'll add an automated smoke test that exercises cache-proxy header paths and validates no connection resets before promoting (PR today).

tilly: i'm taking over follow-ups for the night. ashok — handing off to you for any escalation. will open a follow-up ticket with owners and due dates.

ashok: thanks. i'm marking the incident as mitigated but not fully resolved; moving to post-incident review. if any regressions appear ping @ashok directly.

deploy-bot: Rollback rb-1768510050 completed by kevin at 1768510110.

tess: drafting customer message: brief outage window, impact scope and mitigation steps. will attach SLO impact calc.

jordan: once the runbook updates are in, we'll prepare an exec summary and a list of high-risk rollout patterns.

ashok: final quick note: add a synthetic probe hitting /v1/health and /v1/chat/ready from multiple regions with p99 assertions; if probe fails, trigger pre-paging channel instead of immediate page. (maria to add, 24h).

tilly: handoff logged. will convert the action items into tickets and ping owners. thanks team. :thumbsup:
